Name: Subtle Portrait Edits
Author: Revadahk
Description:
I really disliked how Marlon and Clint looked in the vanilla game so I tried to edit the already improved versions from "Seasonal Outfits" for my own personal use, in doing so I learned a couple of things and in the end I edited a bunch of portraits to better fit my taste.

Installation:
1. Download and properly install both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Download my Zip file, drop the folder "Subtle Portrait Edits" into the "Stardew Valley\Mods" folder, that should be all.

I only edited the faces [i]([s]and some very minorly[/s])[/i], the base mods I adapted them from are:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits, by [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url].
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7116?tab=description]Vanilla Facelift, by [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/67968777]siamece[/url].[left]There are specifications of where each portrait comes from in the "Permissions and Credits" section for anyone interested in knowing.[/left]
